bio: If you’re looking for a relaxed and fun meal out, then Arakataka has you covered courtesy of its cosy atmosphere, friendly service and flexible menus. First, pick your view – beside the huge windows looking out onto the street or opposite the open kitchen – then choose your menu, which comes in a choice of four or six set courses or as smaller snacks. Modern dishes might include halibut tartare with fermented tomatoes or duck breast with cabbage and leeks – and you’ll find the perfect match on the excellent wine list, which offers some impressive verticals from French and Italian producers....
